purpose: Candidate public sources for read-only Florida pilot; each requires independent coverage, freshness, accuracy and reuse-rights validation before client use

candidates.provider: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, National Wetlands Inventory
candidates.caveat: Mapped wetland inventory is not a jurisdictional delineation; missing mapped features cannot be treated as wetlands absent; USFWS state downloads include separate wetlands project metadata for image dates. Do not treat a state-wide release date as the mapping date for a queried polygon
candidates.state_download_published_window: October 2026 posting; per-project mapping/imaging dates remain unverified

candidates.provider: Florida Geographic Information Office / Florida Department of Revenue
candidates.caveat: Official metadata now describes 2026 polygon export, while older cached layer descriptions identified 2025; independently verify exact live edition and relevant county features. Do not fetch owner names/addresses for pilot analysis, assume surveyed boundaries, or approve commercial redistribution without review.
candidates.published_edition_claim: August 2026 (official linked metadata), live feature query not tested

candidates.caveat: Program data are not substitutes for agency decisions; layer-specific rights, vintage, geometry and coverage require review
